description:
The Huffy Go Girl 20" Bike blends fun style with confident riding for growing riders. Its durable steel frame is built for everyday adventures, from neighborhood rides to cruising with friends. Bright colors and playful graphics make every ride feel exciting while helping riders express their personality.
Strong 20-inch wheels and grippy tires provide steady traction on sidewalks, driveways, and neighborhood paths. A durable steel frame keeps the ride sturdy, while the included kickstand makes it easy to park between adventures.
The Go Girl features two braking options to help riders build confidence. A coaster brake allows easy pedal-back stopping, while the front hand brake introduces responsive pull-brake control as skills grow. Comfortable grips and a padded saddle help riders stay steady and comfortable on every ride.
